company.name: Cerafiltec
company.shortDescription: Cerafiltec specializes in providing environmental engineering services that include projection, plant layout design, and plant operation.
company.description:
Cerafiltec provides filtration technology along with the essential engineering design and operating services. 

This enables our local partners to offer the most competitive and reliable treatment solution to their end customers.

Cerafiltec was established in 1993 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

productsAndServices.description: A filtration technology using ceramic flat sheet membranes for water and wastewater treatment, replacing polymeric membranes and improving filtration quality and durability.
productsAndServices.name: Ceramic Flat Sheet Membrane Technology

productsAndServices.description: Service to replace polymeric ultrafiltration membranes with ceramic membranes in MBR systems to reduce clogging and improve operational stability.
productsAndServices.name: Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) Upgrade and Polymeric UF Membrane Replacement

productsAndServices.description: A solution to rehabilitate and increase capacity of existing sand filter systems using compact ceramic membrane modules installed inside existing tanks.
productsAndServices.name: Sand Filter Rehabilitation with Prefabricated Ceramic Membrane Modules

productsAndServices.description: A filtration process combining adsorption with ultrafiltration using ceramic membranes to remove dissolved organics, pathogens, microplastics, and toxins from water and wastewater.
productsAndServices.name: Active Cake Layer Filtration (ACLF) Process

productsAndServices.description: A filtration process that removes total hardness and sulfate from water using ceramic membranes, replacing multi-step treatment systems and sand filters.
productsAndServices.name: Softening Filtration Process Using Ceramic Membranes

productsAndServices.description: A filtration solution for produced water in oil and gas applications using ceramic membranes tolerant to high oil and grease content.
productsAndServices.name: Produced Water Treatment with Ceramic Flat Sheet Membranes
